metadata.name: TechAssembly Precision
metadata.description: Visual theme for a contract electronics manufacturer: industrial-precision direction self-selected from grounded business context while brand desired_character was empty.

decisions.decision: Chosen the "industrial precision" visual direction: cool neutral canvas, deep technical primary, restrained accent, low radii, border-led surfaces and mono eyebrows.
evidence: SiteContext.brand.desired_character is empty — the brand did not prescribe a visual character
proof includes AOI Mirtec MV-7Xi and SMT line Juki RS-1
decisions.reason: Desired_character[] is empty but grounded business context is sufficient (business type, audience, positioning, offers, constraints), so interpretation is not blocked: the direction was self-selected by the interpreter and recorded as INTERPRETER_DECISION.

decisions.decision: Used safe system font stacks and a synthesised palette; no real brand colors or fonts existed.
decisions.reason: Absence of brand inputs does not block interpretation: a safe universal option was applied and recorded as FALLBACK.

decisions.decision: primary is a deep technical color for the single CTA "Запросить расчёт"; accent is a light technical tint reserved for accent surfaces.
decisions.reason: A single primary CTA justifies economical use of the action-accent color and a distinct, restrained accent surface color.

decisions.decision: card_border = 1px line; card_shadow is a narrow soft shadow with negative spread. Surfaces are border-led, not shadow-led.
evidence: positioning.differentiators include AOI inspection and BOM/DFM review
decisions.reason: Technical precision and engineering verifiability read through strict borders and flat surfaces rather than decorative shadows.

decisions.decision: line is a light low-contrast color compensating for the absence of alpha in the v0.1 contract.
evidence: ThemeSpec v0.1: colors.line accepts only #RRGGBB without alpha
decisions.reason: The contract forbids alpha in base colors, so the visual softness of dividers is achieved by choosing a light shade rather than transparency.
